title: Bolgan's Hole
wikitext:
[[File:Bolgan's Hole.jpg|thumb|Bolgan's Hole]]
'''Bolgan's Hole''' is a large cave that houses the most prominent members of the [[Gelkis]] [[centaur]]s. The clan's khan is housed here, and his death is an important step in earning the [[Magram]] centaurs' trust.
